claims.claim: **Conscious state and responsiveness can be difficult to assess. Pay attention to parental concern.**
claims.source_text: Assessment of conscious state and responsiveness may be difficult. Pay attention to parental concern
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Manage the acute seizure as an afebrile seizure**, assessing and treating at the same time if the child is still seizing.
claims.source_text: Manage acute seizure as afebrile seizures … Assessment and management should occur concurrently if the child is actively seizing
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Seizure disorders affect up to half of children with CP**, are linked with worse motor function, and may be hard to control.
claims.source_text: Seizure disorders occur in up to half of children with cerebral palsy They are associated with worse motor function and may be difficult to control
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Stopping intrathecal baclofen causes withdrawal** — dystonia and dyskinesia that can resemble status epilepticus.
claims.source_text: Cessation of intrathecal baclofen can cause withdrawal, presenting as dystonia and dyskinesia resembling status epilepticus
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Consider seizures in:** changed behaviour · deteriorating motor function · sudden falls · cognitive decline · sleep disturbance.
claims.source_text: Seizures must be considered as a differential diagnosis in the following settings: change in usual behaviour deterioration in motor function sudden falls cognitive decline sleep disturbance
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Precipitants:** intercurrent illness · changed or missed anti-epileptic doses · CNS infection · VP shunt malfunction.
claims.source_text: Intercurrent illness eg febrile illness, chest infection, UTI Changes in medication, specifically AED or missed doses of AED … CNS infection VP shunt malfunction
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Missing any AED can cause breakthrough seizures; abrupt withdrawal of carbamazepine or oxcarbazepine causes more severe seizures.**
claims.source_text: breakthrough seizures can occur with missing any of the AED carbamazepine and oxcarbazepine result in more severe seizures upon abrupt withdrawal
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Take a medication history focused on AEDs, benzodiazepines and baclofen**, and the child's seizure types and emergency plan.
claims.source_text: Take a medication history focusing on anti-epileptic drugs (AED), benzodiazepines and baclofen … History of previous seizures, seizure phenotypes, emergency management plan (if in place) and AED
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Count benzodiazepines already given — cumulative dosing and tolerance** — and include the pre-hospital seizure time.
claims.source_text: Benzodiazepine use (consider cumulative dosing and tolerance) Duration of seizure (including pre-hospital period)
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Vomiting, diarrhoea or feed intolerance reduces AED absorption. Ask about drugs that lower the seizure threshold** — eg tramadol, tricyclics, antihistamines.
claims.source_text: Vomiting, diarrhoea or feed intolerance causing reduced absorption of AED Exposure to medications that reduce seizure threshold eg tramadol, tricyclic antidepressant, antihistamine
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Ask about a VP shunt or intrathecal baclofen pump**, examine the shunt, and look for subtle ongoing seizure signs such as eye deviation.
claims.source_text: Presence of VP shunt Presence of intrathecal baclofen pump … Consider subtle signs of ongoing seizure activity eg eye deviation VP shunt if present
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Airway:** optimise head position — **left lateral if aspiration risk**; head-tilt chin-lift or jaw thrust; oro/nasopharyngeal airway for obstruction; suction.
claims.source_text: Optimise head position, consider left lateral position if risk of aspiration Consider simple airway manoeuvres (head-tilt chin-lift or jaw thrust) Consider oro/nasopharyngeal airway for upper airway obstruction Suction secretions/blood/vomit
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Conscious state not improving, or worsening, after a seizure: re-evaluate, consider LP and neuroimaging, and seek senior advice.**
claims.source_text: Failure of improvement of conscious state post seizure or worsening conscious state requires re-evaluation and consideration of investigations including lumbar puncture (LP) and neuroimaging. Seek senior advice
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: ⚠️ **Consider non-convulsive status**, especially with multiple seizure types; it may need EEG. Seek senior advice.
claims.source_text: Consider the possibility of non-convulsive status particularly in those with seizure disorders with multiple seizure types. This may require EEG confirmation. Seek senior advice
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Maintenance AED changes go through the responsible consultant.** Treat any intercurrent illness.
claims.source_text: Adjustments to maintenance AED should be discussed with the consultant responsible … Treat intercurrent illness as appropriate
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Involve the paediatric team** for prolonged seizures, incomplete recovery or status, or rising seizure frequency. **Consider transfer** for status epilepticus or anticipated ICU-level care.
claims.source_text: Consider consultation with local paediatric team when Prolonged seizures, incomplete recovery or status epilepticus Increasing frequency of seizures in a child with a known seizure disorder … Consider transfer when Status epilepticus Children anticipated to required ICU level care (cardiorespiratory compromise)
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23

claims.claim: **Discharge when** back to usual consciousness and function, tolerating AEDs, **with an updated emergency seizure management plan** and follow-up in place.
claims.source_text: Consider discharge when Child is back to usual level of consciousness and function, and able to tolerate AED (if taking) An updated emergency seizure management plan is provided Follow-up in place
claims.locator: The Royal Children's Hospital Melbourne, Clinical Practice Guidelines: 'Cerebral palsy - increased seizures' (Last updated July 2023), at https://www.rch.org.au/clinicalguide/guideline_index/Cerebral_Palsy_Increased_Seizures/, retrieved 2026-09-23
